_comment: Bookkeeping only, no new judgments: the editorial axis for records ruled in Stage 4I batches 1-2 (2026-08-31/09-01) and applied to the manuscript, but never written back to the register. Found because the register was reporting 4I as unfinished when it was not. Every verdict below is transcribed from the ruling that was already applied.

entries.match: The greater the light, the deeper the shadow
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - REFRAME. Under-attribution not repaired by CORRECT: the English is an evolved formulation, so a citation would manufacture precision the evidence does not support.
KEEP - REFRAME. Frame now names the source work: 'Blake's Proverbs of Hell puts it provocatively:'.
KEEP - CORRECT + REFRAME. Turned from a warrant into actual dialogue: the book states the cogito and then answers it.

entries.match: The mind is its own place
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - REFRAME. Internal speaker identified; the line is stronger once it is Satan who says it.
KEEP. Carries an argument the book uses. Apparatus repaired to name Waley's rendering; rights remain HIGH - attribution is not permission.

entries.match: Be in the world but not of it
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - CORRECT by reduction. Verse citation removed rather than corrected; the phrase is a traditional formulation, not a quotable verse.

entries.match: He who knows others is wise
if we were good, we would keep growing
entries.editorial_status: NOT ADJUDICATED - ruled out of scope at the boundary pass; not a provenance object.
